messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 — elevated error rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Error rate >50% for 3m. Paging on-call: @Maya K (primary), @Raj P (secondary)
Maya K: I'm on it. grabbing runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p1-latency. Starting quick triage.
Raj P: on standby, ping me with scope. Any customer impact known?
Maya K: Support shows 5 active tickets and 3 realtime logs from customers seeing 502/timeout. Top affected: model redwood/gpt-13 at ~83% of failures. Correlating with recent runtime deploy.
Tess (eng-oncall): looking at runtime metrics in eu-west-1 — spike in OOMs and a few nodes hitting 100% memory. kubectl output:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep crash
runtime-worker-7b9f  CrashLoopBackOff  OOMKilled
runtime-worker-8f2c  Running  1/2
```
Maya K: I'm going to cordon the worst node and restart the pod. Command: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then `kubectl scale deploy/runtime-worker --replicas=6`
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T09:12:41 by liam -> runtime-service v2.14. Possible rollback candidate. (link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/2026-03-14/1123)
Liam: That deploy touched KV cache config and a lib upgrade. Leaving notes — if memory pressure increases, fallback to previous build is quick. @Noah (infra) did we have kernel updates last night?
Noah (infra-oncall): yes we ran a kernel patch on eu-west hosts 03:40 UTC. I don't see widespread reboots but one host had a corrupted tmpfs. I'm looking at dmesg, will post findings.
Maya K: For now mitigation plan: 1) restart affected pods 2) scale up worker pool 3) temporarily route traffic away from eu-west to eu-central for high latency requests using routing policy `prefer-region=eu-central` (will update routing config)
SupportBot: Notifying impacted customers with a short status: "We are investigating increased errors for generation requests; mitigation in progress." Ticket IDs: #3451, #3454, #3457
Raj P: If we need infra support to repro kernel issue, escalate to infra oncall. Also flagging Security — if any anomalous process spawn, sec team should be looped.
SecurityBot: Acknowledged. If you see unexpected network egress or privileged process forks, DM sec-oncall and open infra ticket.
Tess (eng-oncall): After restart, one worker recovered but another OOMed on warm start. Heap profile points to KV cache growth. Adding a temporary hard cap: `REDWOOD_KV_MAX_BYTES=2000000000` in runtime config and rolling.
Maya K: Rolling config change now via canary (2 pods), then full roll. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime-worker REDWOOD_KV_MAX_BYTES=2000000000 -n runtime`
deploy-bot: Rollout started. Canary pods healthy.
Maya K: error rate dropping from 52% -> 6% in the last 3 minutes. Routing to eu-west still at ~20% but stable. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
Raj P: FYI my shift overlap ends 10:30 UTC and I'm primary after that — small coverage gap from 10:30-10:45 where on-call rotation changes. Maya, can you stay until handoff completes or log the state in the incident channel?
Maya K: I'll stay until 10:40 and do handoff. Handoff checklist: current mitigation (scaled + KV cap), deploy rollback standing by, affected customers, follow-up action item to investigate memory leak in KV cache. Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Noah (infra-oncall): Found repeated oom_kill logs on ip-10-0-5-23 referencing tmpfs and a stale kernel page allocation. I'm marking host as quarantined; we should avoid scheduling there.
Liam: Agree. I'll open a Jira to track a regression test for the lib upgrade and kernel compatibility (JIRA-INC-1284).
SupportBot: Updated customers: "Issue mitigated, service restored in eu-west, profiling ongoing. We'll follow up with RCA." :white_check_mark:
Maya K: Final update: services recovered, error rates normalizing. Creating follow-up P1 RCA doc and scheduling a 1hr postmortem. Tagging owners: runtime (Maya, Tess), infra (Noah), deploy (Liam), support (Support team). Closing paging channel in 15m unless we see regression.
SecurityBot: No suspicious activity detected so far. Standby for logs export if requested.
Maya K: handing off to Raj at 10:40 UTC. All key artifacts are in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2187654322
Raj P: I have the handoff. Monitoring. Thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident channel will remain open for 60 minutes for follow-up notes.
